# css corpus

## Source

Real-world stylesheets, copied unchanged from the packages the npm registry publishes, as jsdelivr serves them: bootstrap's `dist/css/bootstrap.css` and `dist/css/bootstrap-reboot.css`, normalize.css, modern-normalize and Pico's `css/pico.css`, each under the MIT License and named by its prefix in `NOTICE`. This repository has no stylesheet of its own.

## Version

bootstrap 5.3.3, normalize.css 8.0.1, modern-normalize 3.0.1 and @picocss/pico 2.0.6.
